record_type_quote: In the current investigation we focus only on women in a non-overlapping sample of 155 female participants in the latest wave of the Iowa Adoption Studies (IAS).

targets.authors: Beach, SRH; Brody, GH; Todorov, A; Gunter, TD; Philibert, RA
targets.title: Methylation at SLC6A4 is linked to family history of child abuse: An examination of the Iowa Adoptee sample
targets.evidence_quote: Replicating prior research (8), we found that the degree of methylation of the CpG island upstream from SLC6A4 was associated with reported sex abuse during childhood among women.
targets.outcome_quote: Replicating prior research (8), we found that the degree of methylation of the CpG island upstream from SLC6A4 was associated with reported sex abuse during childhood among women.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit confirmation of prior finding in non-overlapping female sample. New mediation and genotype interaction are extensions, and their preliminary status does not negate the replicated association.
